### Uninstall an app — `docs/launcher/uninstall/`

| Feature | Sub-feature | Behavior | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Uninstall an app | Uninstall an app | Bundle identifier. An exact match, or a name inside the app's own namespace. com.apple.iBooksX.CacheDelete belongs to com.apple.iBooksX, but com.apple.iBooksXtra doesn't. A dash also counts as a separator, so dev.zed.Zed-Preview.plist belongs to Zed, unless Zed Preview is also installed, in which case it belongs to Zed Preview. A short vendor prefix like com.adobe never claims everything under it. | NOT PORTED | Out of scope by decision (2026-11-11): the in-app uninstaller is not built. The installer still removes the program and keeps the data. |
| Uninstall an app | Uninstall an app | Command-line tools in /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, ~/.local/bin and ~/bin belong to the app only if they link into the app bundle, never because of their name. | NOT PORTED | Out of scope by decision (2026-11-11): the in-app uninstaller is not built. The installer still removes the program and keeps the data. |
| Uninstall an app | Uninstall an app | Display name. This is the weakest rule, so rows matched this way are labeled "matched by name" and you can check them before you confirm. The name must match exactly, ignoring case and accents, and never as a prefix or part of a word, so "Books" and "Books Reader" can't claim each other's folders. The name also needs at least 3 characters, can't be a standard Library folder name like Preferences or Caches, and can't be shared with another installed app. This rule only applies in Application Support, Caches, Logs and plug-in folders. | NOT PORTED | Out of scope by decision (2026-11-11): the in-app uninstaller is not built. The installer still removes the program and keeps the data. |
| Uninstall an app | Uninstall an app | Group container. Tinycast removes the group. prefix and the 10-character team ID, then applies the rule above. | NOT PORTED | Out of scope by decision (2026-11-11): the in-app uninstaller is not built. This is the weakest rule, so rows matched this way are labeled "matched by name" and you can check them before you confirm. The name must match exactly, ignoring case and accents, and never as a prefix or part of a word, so "Books" and "Books Reader" can't claim each other's folders. The name also needs at least 3 characters, can't be a standard Library folder name like Preferences or Caches, and can't be shared with another installed app. This rule only applies in Application Support, Caches, Logs and plug-in folders. | Out of scope by decision (2026-11-11): the in-app uninstaller is not built. ## 4. Windows additions

Windows-only behaviors that are the natural counterpart of an upstream behavior. They never count toward parity and never replace an upstream behavior.

No Windows additions have been recorded yet.

## 5. Environment note

Evidence in this ledger was produced on Windows 11 (x86_64), with the Rust toolchain pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.

Rows marked `PORTED` were proven by the evidence named in the row. Rows marked `NOT PORTED` are either impossible on Windows or implemented but not yet verified against real Windows behavior; the reason column says which.
